app.title: Life Timeline
app.tagline: Map the moments that shaped your story.

disclaimer.title: A tool for self-reflection, not therapy
disclaimer.body: Revisiting difficult memories can be painful. Go at your own pace, add only what you feel comfortable with, and take breaks. If you are dealing with trauma or feel overwhelmed, please reach out to a mental health professional.

home.heading: Welcome
home.intro: A Life Timeline places the important events of your life along a line, from birth to today. Marking the highs and lows helps you notice turning points, strengths and themes in your own story.
home.savedHint: These are stored only in this browser, on this device.
home.empty: No timelines yet. Create one, or open a .tl file you exported before.
home.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be removed from this browser. This can’t be undone. If you might want it later, export it as a .tl file first.

errors.required: Please enter at least the year.
errors.invalid: This date doesn’t look right. Check the year (1850–2200) and day.

timelineForm.title: Title
timelineForm.titleRequired: Please give your timeline a title.
timelineForm.name: Name (optional)
timelineForm.nameHint: Whose story is this? You can leave it blank.

privacy.title: Your privacy
privacy.lead: We never receive or store your timeline. This app is just a set of tools that runs in your browser.

points.localOnly: Your timeline is saved only in this browser, on this device. It is never sent to us or anyone else.
points.canBeLost: Clearing your browser data, using private/incognito mode, or switching to another browser or device means it won’t be there.
points.backup: To keep a backup or continue on another device, use Export → .tl file, then Open .tl file to load it again.
points.filesAreSensitive: Files you export (.tl, PDF, PNG) contain your personal story. Keep them somewhere safe.

privacy.acknowledge: I understand that my timeline is stored only in this browser and that I’m responsible for exporting a backup.

how.noServer: There is no server or account. The app is a static website and all work happens on your device.
how.blocked: The app tells your browser to block any attempt to send data over the network.
how.exports: Exports are created on your device and downloaded directly. Nothing is uploaded.

timeline.noEvents: No events yet. Start with any memory that feels important. You can always add more later.
timeline.deleteEventBody: “{{title}}” will be removed from your timeline.

eventForm.gentleHint: Only the title and the year are needed. Add as much or as little detail as feels right.
eventForm.title: What happened?
eventForm.titlePlaceholder: e.g. Moved to a new city
eventForm.hasEnd: This lasted for a period of time
eventForm.symbolHint: Optional. Flowers and stones come from the lifeline exercise used in therapy.
eventForm.descriptionPlaceholder: What do you remember about it?
eventForm.reflectionPlaceholder: Looking back, what did it teach you? What helped you get through it?

symbols.flower: Flower: a positive moment or person
symbols.stone: Stone: a painful or traumatic moment
symbols.star: Star: an achievement or proud moment

graph.ariaLabel_one: Lifeline graph of “{{title}}” with {{count}} event. The same events are listed below.
graph.ariaLabel_other: Lifeline graph of “{{title}}” with {{count}} events. The same events are listed below.
graph.empty: Add your first event to start drawing your lifeline.
graph.emptyShort: Add your first event to start.
graph.tapHint: Tap a point on the line to see that event.

chapters.heading: Chapters
chapters.empty: If your life were a book, what would its chapters be? Add periods like “University years” or “Living abroad” to see them on your lifeline.
chapters.hint: A chapter is a period of your life that belongs together. Chapters can overlap.
chapters.name: Chapter name
chapters.nameRequired: Please give this chapter a name.
chapters.ongoing: This chapter is still going on

errors.endBeforeStart: A chapter can’t end before it starts.
errors.beforeBirth: This chapter ends before your date of birth.

chapters.deleteBody: “{{title}}” will be removed. The events from that time stay on your timeline.

support.title: Find support
support.lead: You don’t have to carry difficult memories alone. Talking to someone can help, whether or not you’re in crisis.
support.emergency: If you or someone else is in immediate danger, call your local emergency number now.
support.otherBody: Find A Helpline is a free international directory of crisis lines.
support.privacy: These links open other websites or your phone app. Nothing from your timeline is shared with them.
support.checkInsToggle: Show gentle check-ins while I work

checkIn.title: How are you doing?
checkIn.body: Going back to difficult moments takes energy. Your work is saved, so you can pause whenever you need to.
checkIn.breakIntro: If it helps, bring your attention back to the room around you. Notice:
checkIn.breathe: Then take a few slow breaths, letting each breath out last a little longer than the one before.
checkIn.saved: Everything is saved in this browser. You can close this page and come back any time.

reflection.heading: Reflect on your story
reflection.intro: Take a step back and look at your lifeline as a whole. There’s nothing you have to answer here.
reflection.noTurningPoints: No turning points marked yet. You can mark one on any event.
reflection.questionsHint: Answer any, all or none, in your own words.

questions.themes: Is there a theme that runs through your story?
questions.strengths: What or who helped you through the hardest times?
questions.turningPoints: How did your turning points change you?
questions.patterns: Do you notice any patterns you hadn’t seen before?
questions.values: What matters most to you now?
questions.nextChapter: What would you like the next chapter to hold?

reflection.notes: Anything else you’d like to remember
reflection.saved: Your answers are saved automatically in this browser only, and included in your .tl and PDF exports.

wizard.title: Guided walkthrough
wizard.gentle: If a memory feels too heavy, it’s okay to leave it out, or to add just a short title. You can always come back to it later, or talk it through with someone you trust.
wizard.gentleShort: Add only what feels right. Skipping a period is completely fine.
wizard.promptsIntro: Some questions that may help memories come back:
wizard.addFromStage: Add an event from this time
wizard.onTimeline: On your timeline from this time

cta.heading: Not sure where to start?
cta.body: The guided walkthrough takes you through your life one period at a time, with a few questions to help memories come back.

intro.heading: Let’s walk through your life together
intro.body: We’ll go one period at a time, from your earliest years to today. Each step has a few questions to help memories come back. Add as many or as few events as you like: everything you add appears on your lifeline straight away.
intro.pace: There’s no right or wrong answer and no need to finish in one go. You can skip any step, go back, or take a break and continue later.

earlyChildhood.title: Early childhood
earlyChildhood.p2: Who took care of you? Where did you live?
earlyChildhood.p3: Was there a move, a new brother or sister, or a loss in the family?

childhood.title: Childhood
childhood.p1: What do you remember about starting school?
childhood.p2: Who were your friends, and what did you love doing?
childhood.p3: Were there moments when you felt especially proud, or especially scared or alone?

adolescence.title: Adolescence
adolescence.p1: Which people or experiences shaped who you were becoming?
adolescence.p2: Think of firsts: a first love, a first job, a first big decision.
adolescence.p3: Were there conflicts, losses or big changes at home or at school?

youngAdulthood.title: Young adulthood
youngAdulthood.p1: Did you study, start working, or move somewhere new?
youngAdulthood.p2: Which important relationships began or ended?
youngAdulthood.p3: What were you hoping your life would become?

adulthood.title: Adulthood
adulthood.p1: What were the big commitments: work, a partner, children, a home?
adulthood.p2: What challenges tested you, and what helped you through them?
adulthood.p3: When did you feel most like yourself?

midlife.title: Midlife
midlife.p1: What changed in your work, your family or your health?
midlife.p2: Were there losses, or new beginnings?
midlife.p3: What have you come to value more over the years?

laterLife.title: Later life
laterLife.p1: What has this stage of life brought you?
laterLife.p2: Which people have been most important to you?
laterLife.p3: Which moments from these years would you like to remember?

keyMoments.heading: Key moments
keyMoments.intro: Looking back over your whole life so far, a few moments often stand out. Add them if they’re not on your timeline yet.

high.title: A high point
high.prompt: A moment of great joy, pride or peace. What happened, and who was there?

low.title: A low point
low.prompt: One of the hardest times. Only add it if you feel ready; a short title is enough.

turning.title: A turning point
turning.prompt: A moment when something in you or in your life changed direction.

finish.heading: You’ve walked through your whole timeline
finish.added_one: You added {{count}} event during this walkthrough.
finish.added_other: You added {{count}} events during this walkthrough.
finish.reflect: Take a moment to look at your lifeline. Which turning points stand out? What helped you through the low points? Are there patterns you hadn’t noticed before?
finish.backup: Your timeline is saved only in this browser. Export a .tl file to keep a backup.

export.title: Export timeline
export.localOnly: Files are created on your device and downloaded directly. Nothing is uploaded.
export.failed: Something went wrong while creating the file. Please try again.
export.keepSafe: Exported files contain your personal story. Keep them somewhere safe.

tl.label: Timeline file (.tl)
tl.description: Your backup. Open it later in this app to keep working.

pdf.label: PDF document
pdf.description: Graph plus the full list of events. Good for printing or sharing with a therapist.

png.label: PNG image
png.description: A picture of the lifeline graph.

pdf.footer: Life Timeline · a self-reflection tool, not therapy

footer.privacy: Your data stays in this browser. Nothing is sent to any server.
